title: WHO Medical Product Alert N°1/2023: Substandard (contaminated) liquid dosage medicines identified in WHO European Region and Western Pacific Region
reviewedBy: Claude Code, transcribed from the WHO alert PDF; pending review by Pranshu Rastogi

sources.label: WHO alert PDF with the annex of affected batches

notes: Identified in Uzbekistan (reported 22 December 2022) and Cambodia (reported 3 April 2023; update of 19 May 2023). One DOK-1 MAX batch printed across a line break in the annex ("P/DXS- H/2101", Jul-24) is left out until it is checked against the photograph; DXSH2202's expiry is "not reported".
